<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Exhibit 10.9 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>SAGARD PRIVATE INCOME FUND INC. </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>PROMISSORY NOTE </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">THIS
UNSECURED PROMISSORY NOTE (THIS &#8220;<B><I>NOTE</I></B>&#8221;) HAS NOT BEEN REGISTERED UNDER ANY STATE SECURITIES LAWS OR UNDER THE SECURITIES ACT OF 1933, AS AMENDED (THE &#8220;<B><I>SECURITIES ACT</I></B>&#8221;), IN RELIANCE UPON VARIOUS
EXEMPTIONS THEREFROM. THIS NOTE HAS BEEN ACQUIRED FOR INVESTMENT FOR THE REGISTERED HOLDER&#8217;S OWN ACCOUNT AND NOT WITH A VIEW TO, OR IN CONNECTION WITH, THE SALE, TRANSFER OR OTHER DISTRIBUTION HEREOF. NO SUCH SALE, TRANSFER OR OTHER
DISPOSITION MAY BE EFFECTED, NOR WILL ANY ASSIGNEE OR TRANSFEREE THEREOF BE RECOGNIZED BY THE BORROWER, WITHOUT AN EFFECTIVE REGISTRATION STATEMENT RELATED THERETO OR THE DETERMINATION BY THE BORROWER, IN ITS SOLE DISCRETION, THAT SUCH REGISTRATION
IS NOT REQUIRED UNDER THE SECURITIES ACT, OR UNDER ANY APPLICABLE STATE OR OTHER SECURITIES LAWS OR OTHER APPLICABLE LAWS OF SIMILAR IMPORT. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">THIS NOTE IS ONE OF A SERIES OF PROMISSORY NOTES BEING ISSUED BY THE BORROWER, EACH OF WHICH NOTES IS IDENTICAL EXCEPT FOR ONE OR MORE OF THE
IDENTITY OF THE LENDER THEREUNDER OR ANY REGISTERED HOLDER THEREOF. THE LENDER AND ANY REGISTERED HOLDER, BY ITS ACCEPTANCE OF THIS NOTE, ACKNOWLEDGES AND AGREES THAT THE ACCELERATION OF THE MATURITY DATE UPON THE OCCURRENCE OF AN EVENT OF DEFAULT
AND ANY AMENDMENT OF THE TERMS AND PROVISIONS OF THIS NOTE ARE SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF LENDERS AND REGISTERED HOLDERS HOLDING IN THE AGGREGATE MORE THAN 50% OF THE AGGREGATE INITIAL STATED VALUE OF ALL PROMISSORY NOTES COMPRISING THE SERIES OF
WHICH THIS NOTE IS A PART. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right">Dated: [<B>&#149;</B>], 2026 (the &#8220;<B><I>Original Issue Date</I></B>&#8221;) </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">IN THE PRINCIPAL AMOUNT OF: U.S. $1,000.00 </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">FOR VALUE RECEIVED,
Sagard Private Income Fund Inc., a Maryland corporation (the &#8220;<B><I>Borrower</I></B>&#8221;), HEREBY PROMISES TO PAY to [<B>&#149;</B>] (the &#8220;<B><I>Lender</I></B>&#8221;) a principal amount equal to the Initial Stated Value (as defined
below) on [<B>&#149;</B>], 2056 (the &#8220;<B><I>Maturity Date</I></B>&#8221;). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">For purposes of this Note, the &#8220;<B><I>Initial
Stated Value</I></B>&#8221; of this Note shall be an amount denominated in U.S. dollars equal to $1,000.00. For purposes of this Note, the &#8220;<B><I>Stated Yield</I></B>&#8221; upon this Note shall accrue at a rate equal to 12% per annum on the
Initial Stated Value, payable in cash denominated in U.S. dollars. The Stated Yield shall be payable to the Lender semi-annually in two increments in the manner set forth in the following paragraph. For purposes of this Note, &#8220;<B><I>Past Due
Interest</I></B>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;2.02(a)</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Borrower promises to pay each
respective semi-annual installment of the Stated Yield in arrears on or before June&nbsp;30 and December&nbsp;31 of each calendar year beginning on December&nbsp;31, 2026, and if such day is not a Business Day, then on the immediately preceding
Business Day (each, a &#8220;<B><I>Stated Yield Payment Date</I></B>&#8221;), and on the date on which the Initial Stated Value of this Note, plus any accrued but unpaid Stated Yield (including any Past Due Interest thereon), is paid in full. The
initial Stated Yield period will be the period from, and including, the Original Issue Date to, and including, December&nbsp;31, 2026. Subsequent Stated Yield periods will be the periods from, and including, the January&nbsp;1 or July&nbsp;1
immediately following the most </P>

<P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>ARTICLE I </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>TERMS OF
PAYMENT </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>SECTION 1.01. Prepayments; Prepayment Premium</I></B>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">At any time on or following the date on which the Borrower has repurchased or redeemed the Class&nbsp;I share of common stock, par value
$0.001 per share, of the Borrower (the &#8220;<B><I>Share</I></B>&#8221;) purchased by Lender in connection with the issuance of this Note, the Borrower may upon written notice to the Lender, which notice may be delivered prior to the repurchase of
the Share by the Borrower and will indicate the proposed prepayment date and the Initial Stated Value to be prepaid, prepay in whole or in part the outstanding Initial Stated Value of this Note from time to time and at any time; <I>provided </I>that
(i)&nbsp;the Borrower will pay on the date of such prepayment all accrued and unpaid amounts of Stated Yield (including any Past Due Interest thereon) due through and including the date on which REIT Administration, LLC, in its capacity as the agent
to the Lender hereunder, receives payment for the Share, and (ii)&nbsp;if the prepayment occurs prior to the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">24-month</FONT> anniversary of the Original Issue Date, the Borrower will also pay on the date of such
prepayment a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">one-time</FONT> premium equal to $100.00 on this Note (the &#8220;<B><I>Prepayment Premium</I></B>&#8221;). By signing the Purchase Agreement governing the purchase of this Note (the
&#8220;<B><I>Purchase Agreement</I></B>&#8221;), in connection with any such prepayment, the Lender agrees to submit or cause to be submitted for repurchase the outstanding Share held by such Lender, in accordance with the terms of the Purchase
Agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>SECTION 1.02. Payments and Computations. </I></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Borrower will make each payment on the day when due hereunder in U.S. dollars to the Lender at its address referred to in
<U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;3.02</U> or via electronic payment. All computations of Stated Yield and Past Due Interest will be made by the Lender on the basis of a year of 360 days, consisting of twelve (12)&nbsp;thirty <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">(30)-day</FONT> months, for the number of days occurring in the period for which such amounts are payable. Whenever any payment hereunder is stated to be due on a day other than a Business Day, such payment will be made on
the immediately preceding Business Day, with the same legal force and effect as if made on the actual due date. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>SECTION 1.03.
Registration. </I></B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Note is issued in registered form as to both the Initial Stated Value and Stated Yield (including any Past Due
Interest). The Borrower or its agent will maintain a register (the &#8220;<B><I>Register</I></B>&#8221;) for the recordation of the name and address of any holder of this Note (the &#8220;<B><I>Registered Holder</I></B>&#8221;). The Lender will be
the initial Registered Holder. All amounts of Stated Yield on (including any Past Due Interest thereon), and the Initial Stated Value of, this Note will only be paid to the Registered Holder. If a Registered Holder shall transfer and assign this
Note in accordance with the restrictions on transfer described on the first page hereof, the </P>

Holder to a different Registered Holder. A holder of this Note (including any Registered Holder) does not have the right to convert this Note to bearer form. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>SECTION 1.04. Evidence of Exemption from U.S. Withholding Tax</I></B>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Lender shall deliver to the Borrower, on or prior to the date hereof, and any prospective Registered Holder shall deliver to the Borrower
on or prior to the date on which it acquires the Lender&#8217;s or any other Registered Holder&#8217;s ownership interest in this Note, and at such other times as may be necessary in the determination of the Borrower, the Lender or any Registered
Holder (each in the reasonable exercise of its discretion), an accurate and complete original signed copy of a Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">W-9</FONT> (or a substitute Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">W-9)</FONT> or any successor form
prescribed by the Internal Revenue Service, together with any other certificates or statements of exemption required under the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended, or the regulations issued thereunder, to establish that no deduction or
withholding of U.S. taxes is required with respect to any amounts payable hereunder. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>SECTION 1.05. Notes Comprising a Series.
</I></B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Lender and each Registered Holder acknowledges and agrees that this Note is one of a series of promissory notes (the
&#8220;<B><I>Series</I></B>&#8221;) issued by the Borrower, each of which promissory notes is identical except for one or more of the identity of the lender thereunder or any Registered Holder thereof. The Lender and each Registered Holder, by its
acceptance of this Note, acknowledges and agrees that the rights it may exercise upon the occurrence of an Event of Default (as defined below) and any amendment of the terms and provisions of this Note are subject to the approval of holders of
promissory notes of the Series, the aggregate outstanding Initial Stated Value which represents more than 50% of the aggregate outstanding Initial Stated Value of all of the promissory notes comprising the Series. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>ARTICLE II </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>EVENTS OF
DEFAULT </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>SECTION 2.01. Events of Default</I></B>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The following events shall each constitute an &#8220;<B><I>Event of Default</I></B>&#8221;: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) The Borrower fails to pay the Initial Stated Value of this Note when the same becomes due and payable; or </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) The Borrower fails to pay any amounts of Stated Yield (together with Past Due Interest thereon, if any) on this Note when the same becomes
due and payable, and such failure continues for three Business Days following written notice from the Lender that such payment is past due; or </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(c) The Borrower: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

bankrupt or insolvent, or seeking liquidation, winding up, reorganization, arrangement, adjustment, protection, relief, or composition of it or its debts under any law relating to bankruptcy, insolvency or reorganization for relief of debtors, or
seeking the entry of an order for relief or the appointment of a receiver, trustee, custodian or other similar official for it or for any substantial part of its property and, in the case of any such proceeding instituted against it (but not

<U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;2.01(c)</U>. </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">As used in this <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;2.01(c)</U>,
&#8220;<B><I>subsidiaries</I></B>&#8221; does not include any &#8220;<B><I>Portfolio</I></B><B><I>&nbsp;Entity</I></B>,&#8221; defined to mean any operating entity owned, directly or indirectly through subsidiaries, by Borrower or Other Sagard
Accounts (as defined below) for operational or profit purposes, including, as the context requires, portfolio companies, holding companies, special purpose vehicles and other entities through which the Borrower holds assets. &#8220;<B><I>Other
Sagard Accounts</I></B>&#8221; means, as the context requires, individually and collectively, any of the following: investment funds, vehicles, accounts, products and/or other similar arrangements, other than Borrower and its subsidiaries,
sponsored, advised, and/or managed by Sagard Holdings Manager (US) LLC (&#8220;<B><I>Sagard</I></B>&#8221;) or its affiliates, whether currently in existence or subsequently established (in each case, including any related successor funds,
alternative vehicles, supplemental capital vehicles, surge funds, over-flow funds, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">co-investment</FONT> vehicles and other entities formed in connection with Sagard or its affiliates <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">side-by-side</FONT></FONT> or additional general partner investments with respect thereto). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>SECTION
2.02. Past Due Interest; Remedies Upon Events of Default. </I></B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) Any past due but unpaid amounts of Stated Yield hereunder, from the
date the unpaid amount became past due until such amount is paid in full, shall accrue simple <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">(non-compounding)</FONT> interest payable only in cash at the Past Due Rate as defined below (such amounts,
&#8220;<B><I>Past Due Interest</I></B>&#8221;). For the avoidance of doubt, Past Due Interest shall not itself bear or accrue further interest. For the purposes of this Note, the &#8220;<B><I>Past Due Rate</I></B>&#8221; shall be equal to 12.4% per
annum, computed in accordance with <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;1.02</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) Upon the occurrence and during the continuance of any
Event of Default (including, for the avoidance of doubt, an Event of Default under <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;2.01(b)</U> as to which the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">three-Business-Day</FONT> cure period described therein has already expired
without cure), a Registered Holder may notify Borrower in writing of such Event of Default, after which time the Borrower shall have 90 days to cure such Event of Default. If an Event of Default continues after such
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">90-day</FONT> period, the holders of promissory notes of the Series, the aggregate outstanding Initial Stated Value which represents more than 50% of the aggregate outstanding Initial Stated Value of all of the
promissory notes comprising the Series (such holders being the &#8220;<B><I>Required Holders</I></B>&#8221;) may, upon notice to the Borrower, declare all of the promissory notes comprising the Series (including this Note), and all accrued but
unpaid Stated Yield thereon, to be forthwith due and payable, without presentment, demand, protest or further notice of any kind, all of which are hereby expressly waived by the Borrower; provided, however, that if such Event of Default is an Event
of Default pursuant to <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;2.01(c)</U>, all of the promissory notes comprising the Series (including this Note), and all accrued but unpaid Stated Yield thereon, shall automatically become and be due and payable, without
presentment, demand, protest or any notice of any kind, all of which are hereby expressly waived by the Borrower. </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>ARTICLE III </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>MISCELLANEOUS </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>SECTION 3.01. Amendments, Etc. </I></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">No amendment or waiver of any provision of this Note, nor consent to any departure by the Borrower herefrom, will be effective unless the same
is in writing and signed by the Required Holders and the Borrower, and then such waiver or consent will be effective only in the specific instance and for the specific purpose for which given; <I>provided, however</I>, that no such amendment, waiver
or consent may reduce the Initial Stated Value hereof, or the Stated Yield hereon, or any amounts of Past Due Interest payable hereunder, or delay the date on which any amount of such Stated Yield, Past Due Interest or Initial Stated Value is due
and payable hereunder, unless the Registered Holder shall have agreed to such amendment, waiver or consent. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>SECTION 3.02. Notices,
Etc. </I></B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">All notices and other communications provided for hereunder will be in writing and mailed or delivered via nationally
recognized overnight courier or by electronic mail, if to the Lender or the Borrower, at their respective addresses set forth on the signature page hereof; or, if to a Registered Holder, in such holder&#8217;s name c/o REIT Administration, LLC at
1175 Peachtree Street, N.E., Suite 2200, Atlanta, Georgia 30361, admin@reit-funding.com, or at such other address as shall be designated by such Registered Holder for use in the Register maintained hereunder. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>SECTION 3.03. No Waiver; Remedies. </I></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">No failure on the part of the Lender to exercise, and no delay in exercising, any right hereunder will operate as a waiver thereof; nor will
any single or partial exercise of any right hereunder preclude any other or further exercise thereof or the exercise of any other right. The remedies herein provided are cumulative and not exclusive of any remedies provided by law. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>SECTION 3.04. Binding Effect. </I></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Note will be binding upon and inure to the benefit of the Borrower and the Lender and their respective successors and assigns, subject to
the restrictions on transfer described on the first page of this Note and except that neither the Borrower nor the Lender may assign its rights hereunder or any interest herein without the other&#8217;s prior written consent; provided, that no such
consent shall be required for any assignment or transfer made as a result of the death of the Lender (where such Lender is a natural person). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>SECTION 3.05. Consent to Jurisdiction. </I></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) The Borrower hereby irrevocably and unconditionally submits, for itself and its property, to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Circuit
Court for Baltimore City, Maryland or, if such court does not have or declines jurisdiction, the United States District Court for the District of Maryland, Baltimore Division, and any appellate court thereof, in any action or proceeding arising out
of or relating to this Note, and the Borrower hereby irrevocably agrees that all claims in respect of such action or proceeding may be heard and determined in such courts. The Borrower hereby irrevocably waives, to the fullest extent it may
effectively do so, the defense of an inconvenient forum to the maintenance of such action or proceeding, and waives any and all objections to the laying of venue of any such action or proceeding in such courts. The Borrower irrevocably consents to
the service of any and all process in any such action or proceeding by the mailing of copies of such process to the Borrower at its address specified in <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;3.02</U>. The Borrower agrees that a final judgment in any such
action or proceeding will be conclusive and may be enforced in other jurisdictions by suit on the judgment or in any other manner provided by law. THE BORROWER HEREBY IRREVOCABLY WAIVES ANY AND ALL RIGHT TO TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY LEGAL PROCEEDING
ARISING OUT OF OR RELATED TO THIS NOTE OR THE TRANSACTIONS CONTEMPLATED HEREBY, TO THE FULLEST EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW. </P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) Nothing in this <U>Section</U><U></U><U>&nbsp;3.05</U> will affect the right of the
Lender to serve legal process in any other manner permitted by law or affect the right of the Lender to bring any action or proceeding against the Borrower or its property in the courts of any other jurisdiction. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>SECTION 3.06. Governing Law. </I></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Note will be governed by, and construed in accordance with, the laws of the State of Maryland, United States. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>SECTION 3.07. Tax Treatment. </I></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Borrower (and its affiliates) and Lender will each treat this Note and amounts borrowed thereunder as debt and the relationship between
the Borrower and Lender as that of debtor and creditor, in each case for all U.S. federal, state and local tax purposes and will report consistently with such intent. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>SECTION 3.08. Electronic Signatures. </I></B></P>

the same validity, admissibility, enforceability and legal effect as delivery of an original, manually executed copy of this Note for all purposes. </P>
